_comment: Admin / cheat menu. These are the INITIAL toggle states, read at load and seeded into the F6 menu; after you change a toggle in the menu it lives in the mod's own state, not here. Defaults per the brief: ESP and God mode on, everything else off. Keys mirror the F12 settings schema in admin.nim.
_espMaxDistance: Do not box players farther than this many metres from you. 400 is a sane raid default; raise it for open maps.
